_doc: Hero line (spec #296, H2 #298), books 111/112 (and 100/110 skills moved here only when a Hero ticket ports them). H5 (Power Strike, Slash Blast, Brandish), H7 (Shout, Monster Magnet) and H8 (Panic, Coma) each append their own entries; H6 (#302) owns rush_hero. Power Strike and Slash Blast stay in warrior.json until H5 ports them.

rush_hero.name: Rush
rush_hero.desc: Press the skill key with an arrow key to charge that way, damaging and shoving every monster in your path. Hold to repeat.

text.desc: Press the Rush key with an arrow key to charge that way, damaging and knocking back the monsters in your path. Hold the key to keep charging.

rush_hero._rush: Tier A: WZ 1121006 at fixed rank 1 = WZ level 4 (the survivor rank table for a level-30 skill, ceil(1 x 30 / 8)): damage 78%, mobCount 15, box lt (-170,-50) rb (0,0), whose reach is also the dash distance (field lt.x), action rush2 (stabOF), effect/1..6 and effect0 dust, the Use sound. Tier C: the 2.0 s cooldown (the balance lever), always-on 80 px knockback in the dash direction (bosses resist, no chance field, no RNG draw), hold-to-repeat, no start while climbing, no orb gain or bonus, the bot dashes away from a mob within 60 px, at most every 3 s (BotInput.RUSH_MIN_INTERVAL). Mobility skills do not rank: nothing raises Rush above rank 1 (RunWorld.mobility_rank).
